verdict.rationale: The pack documents a public REST API v2 with list and get endpoints for controls, policies, personnel, risks, audits, frameworks and the evidence library. Those are developer building blocks a user could script an export from, not a documented data-export or portability feature. Nothing describes a bulk 'export all data' function, open export formats, or an offboarding path for leaving the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
